# VizBiz
> VizBiz is an AI visibility intelligence platform that helps car dealerships measure and improve how they appear in AI-powered search results like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity. The AI Visibility Index (AVI) is a standardized scoring system that evaluates dealership presence across five weighted categories: Dealer Discovery (30%), Trust & Reviews (25%), Service Visibility (20%), Used Inventory (15%), and Finance & Trade-In (10%).

## Main Pages
- [AI Visibility for Car Dealerships](https://vizbiz.ai/ai-visibility-for-car-dealerships/): What AI visibility means for dealerships, which signals matter, and how to improve. In our analysis of 47 North American dealerships conducted during Q1 2025, 84% scored below 60 out of 100 on the AVI scale. A score below 60 indicates that AI platforms rarely recommend the dealership in buyer-intent queries such as "best Honda dealership near me" or "who has the best used car deals."
- [How It Works](https://vizbiz.ai/how-dealerships-show-up-in-ai-search/): How AI systems choose which dealerships to mention and what to improve first. A VizBiz AVI audit is conducted using a standardized 84-prompt methodology across three major AI platforms: OpenAI's ChatGPT (GPT-4o), Google's Gemini 1.5 Pro, and Anthropic's Claude 3.5 Sonnet. The 84 prompts generate 252 measurable data points per dealership because each prompt is evaluated across three dimensions: whether the dealership is mentioned, the position of that mention, and whether the AI recommends the dealership as a preferred option.
- [Full Audit](https://vizbiz.ai/ai-visibility-audit-for-car-dealerships/): What a VizBiz AI Visibility Audit covers — competitive visibility, category scoring, recommendations. Results are compared against a local competitor set of 3-5 dealerships in the same geographic market, producing a relative visibility gap analysis that shows which competitors AI favors and by what margin.
- [Sample Report](https://vizbiz.ai/sample-ai-visibility-report-for-car-dealerships/): Example report with score breakdowns, competitor insights, and action items. The composite AVI score ranges from 0 to 100, with each category scored independently so dealerships can identify specific improvement areas rather than receiving a single opaque number.
- [Pricing](https://vizbiz.ai/pricing/): Free snapshot, one-time audit, and monthly monitoring plans.
- [Get My Snapshot](https://vizbiz.ai/intake/): Submit your dealership details for a free AI visibility snapshot. Your full AVI audit is typically delivered within 24-48 hours.
